paras: Scincella forbesorum, also known commonly as Forbes' forest ground skink and la escíncela de bosque de Forbes  in Mexican Spanish, is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Mexico.
The specific name, forbesorum (genitive plural), is in honor of Mr. and Mrs. Dyfrig McHattie Forbes, Mexican planters who assisted visiting herpetologists.
S. forbesorum is known only from the Mexican state of Hidalgo in eastern central Mexico.
The preferred natural habitat of S. forbesorum is forest, to which the common names refer. The holotype was collected at an altitude of 7,000 ft (2,100 m).
The mode of reproduction of S. forbesorum is unknown.
